:::{#def-joint-distribution}
#### Joint distribution

The **joint distribution** of
[jointly distributed](#def-jointly-distributed) random variables $\Xin$
is the function that assigns to each set $A \subseteq \reals^n$
for which $\{(\Xin) \in A\}$ is an [event](probability-basics.qmd#def-event)
the probability $\Pr((\Xin) \in A)$
[@wikipedia_joint_probability_distribution].

:::
